user.title: SeHomeWall
user.description: Adds a "SeHomeWall" notify entity that forwards messages to the SeHomeWall tablet (Alarm tile + spoken aloud).

send_message.name: SeHomeWall: Send message
send_message.description: Sends a message to the SeHomeWall tablet — an entry on the Alarm tile, optionally with an icon, color, and spoken aloud.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text of the Alarm tile entry.

color.name: Color
color.description: Accent color of the log entry.

tts.name: Speak aloud
tts.description: Whether the tablet should read the message aloud.
